jobs.title: Senior FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and maintain financial models to support headcount planning, investment decisions, and resource allocation

 - Deliver business-focused analyses (e.g., spend trends, performance deep-dives)

 - Support strategic and ad hoc projects as Wonderful continues to scale globally

 - Own the monthly FP&A cadence end-to-end (BvA, MoM performance, variance analysis, and management reporting)

 - Own and support budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning across the business

 - Partner closely with teams across GTM, R&D, Operations, and G&A to support planning and decision-making

 - Own data accuracy and reporting flows across Finance, HR, and Business Ops systems


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years of experience in strategic finance, Investment banking, FP&A, or a similar analytical role

 - Experience in a Investment banking / Consulting / high-growth SaaS or tech / AI environment

 - Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and analytical capabilities

 - Hands-on, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning processes end-to-end

 - High ownership mindset and ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment

 - Excellent communication skills and confidence partnering with senior stakeholders

 - Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or a related field

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist - Strategic Partnership
jobs.description:
What You'll Do
Wonderful is the AI operating system for enterprises, helping them close the gap between what AI enables and how they operate today.
This role owns one of our most important global partnerships – a relationship with a leading worldwide consulting firm – and turns it into an engine for growth. You sit at the centre: between the firm's senior leaders and Wonderful's GMs, GTM, and Product teams, aligning priorities and creating value together for enterprise customers around the world.
Think of it as a strategic, pre-sales flavour of Deployment Strategist – a blend of deployment thinking and go-to-market – with the mandate to build this function from scratch. It's global, hands-on, high-ownership, and comes with direct exposure to our CEO and COO.

 - Own and grow one of Wonderful's flagship global partnerships – shaping the strategy and operationalising it across both companies.

 - Become the partner's go-to expert on Wonderful — enabling their senior teams across the globe to understand exactly which business problems we solve and where we can win together.

 - Stay fluent in Wonderful as it evolves, and tailor your pre-sale approach to what matters most to each senior audience.

 - Build lasting relationships – following up with new features and proof points to unlock opportunities with potential end customers.

 - Work closely with Wonderful's GMs and GTM teams to keep priorities aligned as the partnership scales.


Why This Role Exists
Enterprises are ready to use AI – execution and access are the hard parts. Partnerships are one of the fastest ways to put Wonderful in front of the world's largest companies. This role exists to turn one of our most important partnerships into a repeatable, global engine.

Why You Should Join

 - Own one of Wonderful's most strategic and most visible partnerships, with direct exposure to our CEO and COO.

 - Build it from the ground up – the strategy, the playbook, and the function itself.

 - Join what's tipped as one of the fastest-growing startups in Europe, working on agentic AI – the hottest topic in enterprise right now.

 - Work alongside high-agency builders from the best tech companies, solving problems with and for the world's biggest enterprises.


Who You Are

 - Background in top-tier consulting, go-to-market, partnerships, or pre-sales — MBB experience a strong plus.

 - Comfortable holding a room of senior executives and tailoring your message to each audience.

 - Strong strategic and commercial instincts: you turn ambiguity into concrete priorities and plans.

 - Technically fluent — at ease with APIs, data flows, integrations, and demoing AI products.

 - An excellent communicator and stakeholder manager across senior internal and external leaders.

 - High ownership, a bias toward action, and genuine excitement about building something new.

 - Happy to travel regularly to meet partners and customers.


Nice To Have

 - Experience in solutions engineering, technical consulting, or forward-deployed roles.

 - Hands-on experience building or selling AI-powered products.

 - A track record of building or scaling partnerships or go-to-market motions.

 - Experience in high-growth or early-stage environments.


Location: Ideally London-based (negotiable). Some travel involved.

jobs.title: APAC Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Wonderful is looking for a hands-on, commercially driven APAC Marketing Lead to build and scale our marketing engine across the region.

This is a leadership role, but equally a builder role. You’ll lead a team of seven regional marketers across APAC while staying close to execution, local GTM teams and the programmes that drive awareness, engagement and pipeline.

You’ll own the APAC marketing strategy, balancing regional consistency with local-market depth. Working closely with APAC leadership and local GMs/MDs, you’ll translate business priorities and Must-Win accounts into focused marketing plans that deliver measurable commercial impact.


WHAT YOU'LL DO


LEAD APAC MARKETING

 - Own the APAC marketing strategy, priorities, budget and performance.

 - Lead and develop a team of seven regional marketers across key APAC markets.

 - Build a high-performing team with clear goals, accountability and strong execution.

 - Act as the senior Marketing business partner to APAC leadership and local GMs/MDs.

 - Work closely with Central Marketing functions to ensure regional programmes benefit from global scale while remaining locally relevant.


BUILD THE REGIONAL DEMAND GENERATION ENGINE

 - Develop scalable, repeatable programmes that drive Must-Win account engagement, new contacts, pipeline creation and acceleration.

 - Balance locally owned programmes with larger APAC and global initiatives.

 - Measure activity against commercial outcomes, not simply event or lead volume.

 - Turn successful regional initiatives into repeatable playbooks that can scale across markets.

 - Build a strong Partner Marketing motion, working closely with Global Partnerships to leverage strategic partners and programmes across the region.


EVENTS & EXECUTIVE ENGAGEMENT

 - Build a strategic APAC event portfolio across owned events, industry events, executive programmes and partner activations.

 - Ensure programmes are designed around priority accounts, personas and measurable business outcomes.

 - Develop high-value executive engagement programmes across APAC.

 - Partner with Global Field Marketing on major Tier 1 events and sponsorships.


INTEGRATED REGIONAL MARKETING

 - Work closely with Product Marketing, PR & Communications, Partner Marketing, Customer Marketing and Digital to create integrated regional plans.

 - Build strong relationships with hyperscalers and strategic partners to amplify regional activity.

 - Adapt global messaging and campaigns for local markets, cultures and audiences.

 - Champion a local-by-design approach while maintaining a consistent Wonderful brand.


WHO YOU ARE

 - An experienced APAC Marketing leader with a strong B2B enterprise technology background.

 - Proven experience leading distributed Marketing teams across multiple APAC markets.

 - Deep understanding of the APAC enterprise landscape and the differences across markets including Australia, Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, Korea and Southeast Asia.

 - Commercially minded, with strong experience across demand generation, ABM, field marketing and pipeline acceleration.

 - A strong business partner who can work in lockstep with Sales/GTM leadership.

 - Experienced in executive engagement, strategic events and partner/hyperscaler marketing.

 - A builder who remains hands-on, comfortable setting the strategy and then rolling up your sleeves to make it happen.

 - Comfortable operating at speed, making decisions with imperfect information and building structure as the company scales.

 - A strong communicator and relationship builder who can operate effectively across cultures, markets and time zones.
